title: From Install to Autopilot
tagline: The real IronClaw workflow, start to finish
script: Here's what actually happens from install to autopilot — the real IronClaw dev workflow, no hand-waving. Day one: one installer script, then ironclaw onboard. Pick a provider, paste one API key — encrypted at rest — and typing plain ironclaw serves the web UI: session timeline, logs, file browser, approval gates. Next, connect where you live: Telegram or Slack — your agent's front door. Then equip it: ironclaw extension install github. Forty-nine sandboxed tools behind one credential — reads run on allow, writes stop and ask. Now the loop. Give it an issue. It reads the code with file tools, patches it — and if you set a post-edit check, every save runs your compiler and feeds new warnings straight back, so it fixes itself before you ever look. Branch, fix, pull request, comment — the loop closes. Put it on a schedule — every weekday at eight: triage my open PRs and send me a digest — then approve the routine once. Teach it your playbooks as Markdown skills — thirty-two ship in the box. From prompt to PR — while you sleep.

cards.text:
$ ironclaw extension install github
installed: true

$ export IRONCLAW_POST_EDIT_CHECK="cargo check"
write_file src/retry.rs ✓
post_edit_check: warning: unused `attempts` (NEW)
apply_patch src/retry.rs ✓
post_edit_check: no new diagnostics
